projects.name: blackhole-threats
projects.body: Turns threat feeds into BGP blackhole routes through GoBGP, and keeps a feed's last good routes when it fails.
facts: Signed APT repository and a GHCR image

projects.name: s3ctl
projects.body: Provisions S3 buckets, each with its own IAM user and key scoped to that bucket alone, and plans every change first.
facts: Homebrew tap, signed APT repository and GHCR

projects.name: s3mirror
projects.body: Mirrors every bucket between S3-compatible endpoints, copying only new or changed objects, in parallel.
facts: Homebrew tap and a GHCR image

projects.name: zquota
projects.body: Shows Z.ai quota use and exactly when each window resets, with exit codes cron can act on.
facts: Homebrew tap, signed APT repository and pip

projects.name: joflux
projects.body: Moves a whole GitHub organisation into Forgejo or Codeberg in five stages, and never deletes the originals.

projects.name: odysseusai
projects.body: Independent images of the Odysseus AI workspace, built from upstream and booted with the full stack before they're tagged.
install: cd odysseusai && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d
